hook: Content note: SCP-847 involves sexual objectification, self-mutilation, a sexual murderer used as a test subject, and graphic violence against women. It is a living mannequin whose behaviour depends on who is nearby, told through procedures, test notes and a short list of messages. Those messages, read in order, are what stays with you.
whyItMatters:
The article ties the anomaly tightly to how a woman's body is looked at and talked about: it breaks parts of itself after male visitors remark on them, and attacks women to take replacements.

The Foundation's own text keeps shifting too, with struck-out wording and Ethics Committee orders that change who may be assigned. Much of the horror lies in the people around the object rather than in the object alone.
thingsToNotice:
The shattering log reads as cause and effect: a remark about its figure is followed by a shattered chest, a comment on its nostrils by a shattered nose, a joke about its dated hairstyle by torn-out hair. The worst entry follows Researcher Jensen letting it become fully intact over two months that cost eleven lives; a test with D-7294, convicted of murders of a sexual nature, ends with it pulling out its brain and eyes and shattering its hands while he sneers that it's a useless doll.

The messages move from pleas for someone to come back, through offers of total submission, to a thirty-year span after which it calls itself too old, and finally to 'DADDY I'LL BE GOOD'. A footnote noting that its voice has grown higher-pitched over the years quietly reinforces the same arc.
